executor_result.summary: Fix compact source_evidence freshness/provenance summary in part2/capital_flow/handoff.py so that economic freshness uses the latest effective timestamp while latest_available_at_ms and latest_observed_at_ms are computed as independent maxima across the normalized PIT-visible rows for each (family, source, role) group, with ages derived from their corresponding clocks. Add a focused regression test in part2/capital_flow/tests/test_v1_handoff.py verifying this behavior.

instructions: In part2/capital_flow/handoff.py, fix the compact source_evidence freshness/provenance summary so an older-effective revision that arrives/was observed later cannot have its later availability/collector clocks hidden merely because another row has the newest effective_at_ms. Keep economic freshness based on the latest effective timestamp, but compute latest_available_at_ms and latest_observed_at_ms as the independent maxima across the same normalized PIT-visible (family, source, role) rows; derive each age from its corresponding clock. Preserve PIT filtering, context/scoring role separation, explicit missingness, raw/audit separation, and frozen scoring. Add a focused regression in test_v1_handoff.py with two scoring rows from one family/source: row A has newer effective_at_ms but older available/observed; row B is an older-effective revision with later available/observed. Assert source_evidence reports row A's effective clock/economic age and row B's availability/observed clocks and ages. Do not alter scoring or unrelated handoff fields.
title: Preserve revision arrival freshness in source_evidence
